summary:
• Gemini 4 Neon — Google DeepMind’s new multimodal model that handles million‑token contexts across code, documents, audio and video, enabling unified data synthesis.
• Claude Code — Anthropic’s coding assistant now includes auto‑mode for Opus and Sonnet on major cloud platforms, providing seamless, safer code generation without prompt permission.
• The jagged frontier — OpenAI’s research brief outlining how coding agents accelerate AI research, highlighting speed gains and remaining performance gaps to guide future engineering.
• datasette‑arrows — a community plugin for Datasette that streams query results in Apache Arrow format, allowing analysts to export massive datasets efficiently for downstream tools.
• IBM and Confluent time‑series foundation models — built‑in functions for Apache Flink that deliver forecasting, anomaly detection and semantic intelligence directly in SQL, enabling real‑time predictive actions.
• YouTube creator‑led slate — new premium series from Emma Chamberlain and Nick DiGiovanni backed by top producers, signaling YouTube’s push into high‑quality creator‑driven entertainment.
